heading: Application of this subchapter to Hawaii
lead: This subchapter as heretofore and hereafter amended, shall apply to the State of Hawaii.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was enacted as a part of the Hawaii Omnibus Act, and not as a part of the Small Reclamation Projects Act of 1956 which comprises this subchapter.
